excerpts: We trade above a Swing High on the 4h, if we look at the 1h to monitor 2CR
If the 1st Candle or 2nd Candle rejection high remains intact and is not traded above, we’re respecting the Swing High.
But if the rejection high now gets run, we’re disrespecting the Swing High
Either you have multiple arguments/options of things that can happen, when that’s the case, you wait.
2CR fails because the rejection high gets run, we’re now only left with one option and one-sided arguments: Bullish.
